description:
All information provided is STRICTLY VOLUNTARY: The purpose of this Sources Sought Notice is to query the market for potential interested, capable, responsible, and qualified small business offerors that can provide/perform the stated requirement. The government is interested in collecting market data/information in accordance with Federal Acquisition Regulation (RFO) Part 10.

Please see the attached Sources Sought and Draft Performance Work Statement (PWS).

Responses are due by 30 April, 2026 at 12:00pm CST. 

The contractor is to provide all necessary equipment, labor, and supervision to lease, install, and maintain temporary Heating, Ventilation, and Air Conditioning (HVAC) systems for six Military Working Dog (MWD) kennels located at Joint Base San Antonio-Lackland, Texas.
